Theorem
[Evolution of the minimizing Harnack two-tensor] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0315, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0316 ↗ def:chow-ii-hamilton-harnack-quadratic ↗ lem:chow-ii-evolution-of-p-tensor ↗ lem:chow-ii-evolution-of-m-tensor 1. ch15:15.25\group Minimizing Harnack Tensor

As long as $Z\ge 0$, write $Q$ as a sum of squares with coefficients $Y^N_{ab},X^N_a$. Define \[ K_{avtu}= abla _vP_{tua}-S_{ijrs}P_{ija} abla _vR_{rstu} +R_{tuaw}R_{vw}+ rac1{2t}R_{tuav} \] and \[ L_a^{NM}=2Y_{id}^NY_{jd}^MS_{ijk\ell }P_{k\ell a} +Y_{ah}^NX_h^M-Y_{ah}^MX_h^N. \] Then \[ ( abla _t-\Delta )Z_{ab}=2S_{mntu}K_{avut}K_{bvmn} +\sum _{N,M}L_a^{NM}L_b^{NM}- rac2tZ_{ab}. \]
Proof

\sketch Differentiate $Z=M-S(P,P)$. The inverse identity $S\Rm =I$ gives $( abla _t-\Delta )S=-S(( abla _t-\Delta )\Rm )S$ together with the two gradient-square correction terms. Substitute the evolutions of $M,P,\Rm $ and complete the derivative terms into $2S(K,K)$. The remaining algebraic terms are expanded using $R=\sum _NY^N\otimes Y^N$, $P=\sum _NY^N\otimes X^N$, and $M=\sum _NX^N\otimes X^N$; they are exactly $\sum _{N,M}L^{NM}\otimes L^{NM}-2Z/t$.
